notes.title: Pyramis 1.0.0 + Future development plans
notes.content:
It's finally here! Pyramis 1.0.0! ...Now, you may notice that barely anything has changed in this update. Don't worry! I'll explain after these patch notes:

[list]
[*] Adjusted the order of the colors in palettes 4 & 5 to further emphasize the intent of a respective "warm" and "cool" palette when playing with 3 colors. When I decided the original order of the colors, I had this idea that the first color of the palette had to be the color most similar to red. I thought about it a little more, and actually, never mind, that's dumb. (Aside from some very slight tweaks for contrast reasons, the original color scheme is still available when playing with 4 colors.)
[*] Adjusted the colors of palette 6. The original white colored block looked strange when the highlight effect was applied to it, so it's been changed to a cool off-white.
[*] Version number is no longer shown in-game.
[/list]
As for the final-looking version number... The version of Pyramis that I've been developing started out as a messy prototype, and I've been building on top of it to turn it into what it is now. As more people play the game, and more features are suggested... I'm beginning to realize how unstable of a foundation the original prototype has become.

It was a very difficult decision to make, but I've decided that this version of Pyramis is finished! As a prototype, it does what it needs to do by demonstrating the gameplay of Pyramis and I'm not going to be working on it anymore...

...because I have to start all over again.

This comes with both good news and bad news. For you, the good news is that this generally isn't your problem and you don't actually have to do anything! When this "remake" of Pyramis is ready, you'll just receive it as another update. Also, the game is going to become a lot better, with lots of really nice QOL features (some of which have already been implemented in the remake). The bad news is that this update... will probably take a while. Please be patient as I work on this new version.

For me, the good news is that I'll be able to keep adding things to the game without worrying about everything falling over like a house of cards. The bad news is that... I have so much work to do. Please raise your arms in real life and lend me your strength anime-style as I work on this new version.

TL;DR Pyramis is going to get an update soon that makes it a lot better, but it's going to take a while. Be patient, but get excited!

notes.title: Pyramis 0.3.2
notes.content: [list][*][p]Mirage, the mascot of Pyramis, has been added to the game! She appeared in the background of the old trial version, and if you looked closely, you'd have noticed that she was always in the taskbar icon... but now she'll be right next to your board, cheering you on as you play![/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Originally, the alternate block palettes were implemented as an accessibility option for colorblind players, but players without colorblindness still chose them for the sake of playing with different colors... so additional palettes have been added! Now those with full color vision can play with palettes such as "Warm Sunset" and "Cotton Candy" instead of "Muddy Dark Yellow That Was Only Added As An Option In Case You Need To Resort To It To Perceive The Game"[/p][/*][*][p]In addition to this, the red-green colorblindness palette's colors have been reordered to look nicer when playing with 3 colors.[/p][/*][*][p]Copyright screen has been added at the start to clean up the presentation of the title screen. Screens will now also prompt you to "PRESS START BUTTON" when you're able to begin the game.[/p][/*][*][p]"MINI PYRAMID BONUS" has been renamed to "MINI PYRAMID CLEANUP" to better explain what the intent and benefit of that mechanic is.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Pyramis 0.3.1
notes.content:
This version fixes an issue I noticed when watching [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vh-4Qq0fa7Q]gameplay from Notester82[/url] (Thank you for streaming Pyramis, and sorry about the bug!)

[list]
[*]Fixed an issue that caused crush scores to be incorrectly calculated at certain speed settings. The entire score was supposed to be rounded down to prevent issues with decimal numbers, but by mistake, it was only applied to the game speed multiplier! This means that playing at x1.5 speed would only earn you a x1.0 multiplier, and playing at x0.5 speed would apply an absolutely devastating x0.0 multiplier.
[/list]
I apologize for this mistake. The speed multiplier option was added last minute before the Steam launch, and probably should have been tested further. I suppose this is also the nature of Early Access, though. I'd like to thank all of you Early Access players for supporting me as I figure these things out.

With these being the first patch notes on Steam, I will use this opportunity to mention- please do not hesitate to point out any bugs or other issues you find in the Steam discussions or the Itch community! I'm very grateful for the handful of you who are enjoying the game and will do my best to ensure it's the best it can possibly be for all of you.
